en: This postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a grand palace-like building set behind a pond with swans. To the right is a long, columned pergola or covered walkway, leading the viewer's eyes into the distance. Bare trees surround the scene, suggesting fall or winter. The text 'Bad Pyrmont. Fürstliches Schloss.' is printed at the top. The reverse side includes a plan view sketch of a building, a stamp for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and publisher information 'Ernst Schnelle, Pyrmont.'
